package.name: harambe_policy_controller
package.description: ros2_control controller running ONNX RL policy with PD + gravity compensation. Port of the Gazebo HarambePolicyPlugin to real hardware (EtherCAT CST mode). Builds 93-dim observation from joint states and dual IMU, runs inference at 50 Hz, converts target positions to joint torques via PD + KDL gravity compensation.
